text: Igihe za otobisi zigenewe gutwara  banyeshuli zihagaze kugirango zibafate cyangwa bavemo ugomba :

options.text: gukomeza ugabanyije umuvuduko n'ubwitonzi  kuko bishoboka ko abanyeshuli bakwambuka bitunguranye

text: Mugihe ukurikiranye na romoruki,n'ukubera iki ugomba gusiga umwanya uhagije hagati yawe nayo?

options.text: Bifasha umuyobozi wa romoruki kukurebera mundorerwamo.

text: Iyo icyerekezo 1 kireba amashami y'inzira nyabagendwa mu ntara nyinshi, icyerekezo gifatwa na:

options.text: Komite y'igihugu ishinzwe umutekano mu muhanda

text: Ibice by'umuhanda byera bigari biteganye n'umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo ,kabiri bisobanura:
Ni ubuhe buryo bwiza bwakurikizwa igihe hari umuntu wakomerekeye mu mpanuka yo mu muhanda ?

options.text: Kutamukuramo keretse mugihe hari ibyago byaterwa n'inkogi y'umuriro   cyangwa akaba ashobora kugongwa n'ikindi kinyabiziga no guhamagara ababishinzwe
Gusaba uwakomeretse kunyeganyeza ibice by'umubiri  kugirano umenye aho ibikomere bye bigarukira

text: Iyo ubugari bw'umuhanda budahagije kugira ngo babisikane nta nkomyi, abayobozi bategetswe:
Ugeze ahari inzira yabanyamaguru barindiriye kwambuka. Ntibatangiye kwambuka , wakora iki?
Kuki abanyamaguru batemerewe kwambuka umuhanda mw'ikoni cyangwa hafi y'imodoka ihagaze?

options.text: Abandi bayobozi bi binyabiziga baza bashobora kutabona abambuka umuhanda

text: Birabujijwe kugenza cyangwa gukomeza kugenza ikinyabiziga gifite ubuhagarike burengeje:
Amategeko ntayegayezwa ashyirwaho n'iteka rya Perefe, ntashobora kumara igihe kirenze:
Abagenzi bicaye ku ntebe zifite imikandara kimwe n'umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga bagomba:
Niryari amatara ndanga cyerekezo agomba kugaragazwa  kubandi bakoresha  umuhanda ?

options.text: igihe gusa ari ngombwa  amenyesha ibindi binyabiziga bimukurikiye
igihe gusa aringombwa kuburira abandi bayobozi bava mukindi cyerekezo
mugihe gikwiye ushaka kumenyesha abandi bakoresha umuhanda icyo ugiye gukora
keretse ahari  ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda byerekana icyerekezo cyawe

text: Igihe ibyangombwa by'ingenzi bicitse, ikizirikisho cyo gutabara gikoreshwa gusa:

options.text: Kugira ngo ikinyabiziga gikururwa kigende neza
Kugira ngo ikinyabiziga kigere aho kigomba gukorerwa

text: Mu gihe hari undi muyobozi  w'ikinyabiziga ugukurikiye watangiye kukunyuraho :

options.text: Ntugomba kugira undi muyobozi w'ikinyabiziga  unyuraho
Ugomba kunyura kukindi kinyabiziga uvugije ihoni

text: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakora iki igihe ageze ku  kazamuko gashinze cyane ?

options.text: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agomba kugabanya umuvuduko akaguma kuruhande rw'iburyo yirinda  ibyago
Gukandagira ikirenge cya amburiyage no kuvuza ihoni ryo kumunyesha
Kugumana umuvuduko n'ikirekezo wari ufite mu muhanda

text: Umuyobozi agomba gukora uko ashoboye kugira ngo yirinde kwangiza umuhanda:
Gukoresha ingenzura ry'itegeko, igenzura rigomba gutangira nyuma y'imyaka:

options.text: Imyaka 2 nyuma yo gushyirwa mu muhanda
Imyaka 3 nyuma yo gushyirwa mu muhanda
Umwaka 1 nyuma yo gushyirwa mu muhanda

text: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakora iki igihe ageze aho banyura bazenguruka?

options.text: Tanga inzira ku binyabiziga byamaze kwinjira aho banyura bazunguruka
Tanga inzira gusa  niba uri munzira ya kabiri niya gatatu isohoka
Komeza kuko abandi bayobozi b'ibinyabiziga  bagomba kuguha inzira  yo gukomeza

text: Ishyirwaho ry'ibimenyetso ku mihanda y'igihugu n'iy'imijyi rigenwa na:

options.text: Icyigo gishinzwe kugenzura ibigendera mu muhanda

text: Igihe imodoka iparitse ku nkengero z'umuhanda  mugihe cy' ijoro :

options.text: Umuntu ufite uruhushya rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga agomba kuba yicaye mu mwanya w'umuyobozi
Amatara yo guhagarara  umwanya munini aguma yaka

text: Uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe bujya mu cyome bwerekanwa n'ibyapa:
Iyo begereye ibyome, abayobozi bagomba gutondekanya imirongo:
Ni ayahe matara agomba kwakira rimwe ku binyabiziga?

options.text: Amatara ndangambere, kamenabihu y'imbere n'amatara ndangacyerekezo

text: Igihe ubonye icyapa  kigaragaza ishuli wakora iki?

options.text: gukomeza n'umuvuduko uri hejuru  kuko umunyeshuli  agomba gutegereza

text: Niki wakora igihe utabona neza usubira inyuma ?

options.text: Gushaka umuntu uri hanze y'ikinyabiziga  ukuyobora

text: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabizaga ashobora kunyuranaho:

options.text: igihe umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga kiri imbere ye amweretse ikimenyetso kimwemerera kunyuranaho

text: Bavuga ko ikinyabiziga kiri mu igerageza iyo:

options.text: Kiri muri kaburimbo bakumva uko bigenda
Kigendeshwa n'abagikoze, abakiguze, abacyongeyeho karisoro, abakigurisha n'abongera kukigurisha
